milestones.title: Revisited when the development round trip or a partner sample uses one of these forms (45.2-10, 45.2-12)

remediation: Some forms of OpenTDF objects are not read yet: NanoTDF, objects whose key is split across several key servers, remote key access, and post-quantum key access addressed to your organization's own key. Such objects are refused with a plain sentence; post-quantum key access addressed to a partner's listed key server opens through that server. Each form is added when a development or partner sample uses it. Source: .planning/phases/45.2-nato-and-five-eyes-exchange-part-2-ztdf-and-the-nato-texts/45.2-CONTEXT.md D-24.
title: Some OpenTDF forms are refused as not supported yet
